agents.prompt:
Run the Playwright test in the math-detective project at F:\CODEX\math-detective. 

Steps:
1. First, start the dev server by running: cmd /c start /B npm run dev  (in F:\CODEX\math-detective)
2. Wait 10 seconds (use: ping -n 11 127.0.0.1 >nul)
3. Run: npx playwright test tests/e2e/pattern-step-loop.spec.ts --reporter=list
4. Report the full output including pass/fail counts

The Playwright config already has reuseExistingServer: true and webServer configured, so it can also auto-start the server if needed.
